defaults.status: agent proposal, written by Codex 2026-11-15 at Ben's ask

press.scale: Press-in scale 0.97 over 150 ms, duration-based spring dampingRatio 1; release or cancellation returns to 1 over 300 ms with dampingRatio 1 from the live value. Release inside commits once; release outside or responder cancellation commits nothing. Next press interrupts return immediately.
press.highlight: List rows: gray token highlight at full row bounds over 150 ms, no scale; release/cancellation clears in 150 ms. Inputs: native focus/caret and selected text, no scale.
press.opacity: Bar buttons: opacity 0.4 over 150 ms; release/cancellation returns to 1 in 150 ms; no scale or added background.
press.none: No app press animation; direct gestures and native text controls follow the finger or native focus.
press.reduce: Scale becomes opacity 0.7 in 150 ms and restores to 1 in 150 ms. Other feedback remains opacity/highlight or native. No position/size animation.
press.commit: No haptic or mutation on press-in. Cancelled gestures and disabled targets produce no committed input. A child action consumes its own tap; the parent card does not also open.

motion.ease: brand/tokens.css --ease-out = cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1). Custom enter 300 ms, exit 200 ms; selection 200 ms; feedback 150 ms. Native default ms=0 is an app-added-motion budget, never a promise about system animation duration.
motion.interrupt: Any next touch cancels obsolete custom motion or grabs its current value; no interaction waits for an animation timer. Retain committed job state when leaving.
motion.frequency: constant: typing, scrolling, tab changes and Back, no custom content transition; required press feedback still applies. tens: subtle feedback or 200 ms state continuity where frontend-standard explicitly names it. occasional: native/modal/sheet 300 ms enter, 200 ms exit. rare: a real sale may use sold 300 ms, dampingRatio 1, one field fill and success haptic/sound on acknowledgment. Reduce Motion: final state immediately or 150 ms crossfade; sale haptic only.
motion.failure: A new failure fades its brick badge once over fieldsFill 150 ms, warning once on acknowledgment; no shake or loop; Reduce Motion shows badge immediately.

states.idle: Show its current value, selection and concise action label; retain native accessibility role, label, value, expanded/checked/selected state.
states.pressed: Use press.feedback; never move neighbours or alter measured width.
states.disabled: Disabled is visible at inkDisabled or native disabled opacity with its reason beside it; ignore tap and do not emit a committed user.input. Source-only read rows and group IDs have no target.
states.loading: Local navigation is latched through mount. Requests latch one operation ID before yielding. Delay visible progress 150 ms, retain it at least 300 ms, preserve control width and show real job progress after 1 second. Never turn latency into fake progress.
states.done: Local selection shows its check/value immediately. Navigation removes the source target from hit testing. A mutation shows its acknowledged result in place; completed approval becomes noninteractive. Show Undo for 5000 ms only if a valid inverse or unsent cancellation exists. Retain partial site failures.
states.failed: Retain draft and current successful results, name the failing step and expose Retry for unfinished work; retry is idempotent. A local-only read or selection has no invented network failure.

defaults.haptic: Optional per device settings; one semantic punctuation per commit. none for navigation, scrolling and typing; selection for a changed discrete selection; light for an explicit mutation; warning once on a newly reported failure; success only on acknowledged sale or completed real job. Native haptics count, never add a second custom vibration. No haptic is the sole indication.
defaults.space: 44 pt minimum touch target; visible buttons 48 pt at foot, 40 pt pills/icons with hit expansion up to half the neighbour gap. Gutter 20; within a thing 8/12; cards 16; sections 32. Preserve safe-area and keyboard insets, Dynamic Type and a nonoverlapping target for each adjacent action. Large content scrolls; do not clip or truncate required actions.
defaults.sheet: One topmost formSheet; native medium/large detents and grabber, medium initial unless specified large; keyboard expands to large and restores on dismissal. Only the top layer accepts touch. Task queues use fullScreenModal with their own stack/Close. System photo/share/browser/calendar/auth controllers keep native dismissal. Destructive confirmation uses native action sheet, not another stacked JS sheet.
defaults.log: Use log.input => user.input and log.show => ui.show with session, seq, build, seed and entity IDs. ui/press logs the committed tap before dispatch. Log text under masked text, never value. Log each committed selection or gesture once at release/settlement, accessibility adjustments identically. state.change records was/to, item.action uses lifecycle names; log.call wraps native/HTTP calls with call.start/end and error. No new event names, no raw addresses, codes, email, message text or credentials in unmasked fields.
defaults.aliases: A source group ID or kit forwarding template is explicitly marked noninteractive. Its child ID rows are the actual targets. gesture: names are spec-only aliases for currently idless surfaces, not claims that testIDs were added. A repeated ID has exactly one JSON record; screen-specific cases are in result.back. Instantiated and generic templates are audited separately, never both logged for one touch.

result.back: Restore the immediately preceding room-plan edits and posting choices; leave the room plan visible. Back first dismisses keyboard or temporary picker, then follows the screen stack. Edge swipe follows the same rule. Committed changes persist. Toast stays for 5000 ms, pauses expiry while VoiceOver focus is on it, and disappears after successful Undo. No new toast may silently replace an unresolved inverse failure.

haptic.when: Once after validation when one explicit operation is accepted; no repeat for retry of the same operation. Never on press-in or scroll.

states.disabled: Disable when required values are invalid or missing, the entity is no longer actionable, or this operation is in flight; show the exact reason.
states.loading: Latch one operation ID synchronously before awaiting; ignore further taps. Preserve width. After 150 ms show the named step for at least 300 ms; after 1 second show real stage/site progress. Offline: Waiting for signal, never Done. Retry reuses the operation ID.
states.failed: Retain this action and values. Show one brick failure badge, failed site/step and Retry; warning haptic once on arrival. Retry only unfinished work with the same operation ID. Never claim external successes rolled back.

{d.id}-acc.log: user.input(screen, control={d.id}-acc, value=tap); ui.show for the resulting visible state. state.change; call.start/call.end for each outside call; error on failure; decision.answer when resolving a decision; item.action for a lifecycle step.

result.back: If the displayed button includes a suggested amount, send that exact counter once; otherwise open the Counter amount formSheet. In either case a below-floor amount requires a warning and second tap at the unchanged amount. formSheet; detents medium and large, initially medium; expand to large for keyboard or overflowing content. Back, scrim or downward dismissal closes the sheet and restores its trigger and scroll position. Unsaved modal work asks Discard or Keep editing. Edge swipe never pops the page behind the sheet.

motion.name: sheet
